behaviours.summary: The creating constructor rejects a null value and applies the slice's event, so a new aggregate starts with one event.
applyPlaceholder applies the slice's event and returns true when the value changes, and returns false without applying anything when the aggregate already holds that value.
No business invariant is guarded before apply(); only a null value is rejected, and the real guard is left to the developer.
The aggregate holds a single placeholder String; its real state, and the event handlers that write it, are left to the developer.
Loads an aggregate by id rebuilt from its events (failing, or returning empty, when it does not exist), reports whether one exists, and persists a new one.
Writes every event variant of the aggregate with an @type discriminator, so the stream's events round-trip through JSON.
The handler loads the aggregate by the command's id and calls its decision method, which applies the slice's event when the value changes.

A redelivered event finds its TodoList already started and returns before dispatching or saving again.
The send of the next command is commented out, so the TodoList is marked dispatched but nothing is sent; the command to dispatch is left to the developer.
No handler exists for the events that advance or complete the process, and the TodoList is never marked completed; they are left to the developer.
Attempts are never counted and no compensating command is issued on terminal failure; bounded retries and compensation are left to the developer.
